---
# No title, subtitle or author: Quarto only emits a title slide when one of
# those is set, and this deck deliberately opens straight onto blank paper.
#
# Everything below is a stack of empty slides. Each `---` starts a new one, so
# the slide count is just the number of separators — add or delete lines to
# change how many pages you have. Nothing is typeset on any of them; you write
# on them straight away with an Apple Pencil / mouse: the deck is always in
# drawing mode.
#
# Ink is stored per slide, keyed by slide *index*, so inserting a separator in
# the middle shifts everything after it onto the wrong page. Add new slides at
# the end. The drawing tools are available as soon as the deck opens.
#
# Deck-wide settings (theme, drawing plugin, dimensions) live in _quarto.yml.
